name: email-sequence-designer
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and the other hosts the skills CLI supports
short: Plans welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase and cold-outbound email flows with timing, exit rules, send caps and a sunset path.
what: You tell your agent which flow you want and what triggers it. The skill maps each flow's trigger, step timing, branch and exit conditions and goal. It adds a global send cap, quiet hours and a fatigue guardrail, plus a path for re-engaging and then retiring people who stop opening. It scores the plan on the pack's SEND framework. It plans the flow only, and other skills in the same pack write the emails and audit the program.
who: Marketers and founders setting up lifecycle email in a platform like Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot or Customer.io. It doesn't write the emails, so add email-creative-builder from the same pack if you want copy too.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills
Optional: an export of your current flows from your email platform, and GA4 or store data for timing

steps.title: Describe the flow
steps.text: Give the flow type, your email platform, the trigger event and the audience. Paste a list or segment export if you have one.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Build an abandoned-cart sequence: [N] steps, [timing], with a discount branch and an exit-on-purchase condition."

watch: With Resend as your email platform, it can create and send broadcasts. The skill treats creating and sending as two separate steps, each needing your go-ahead.
When you confirm, it saves results into a `memory/` folder in your project.
